title: ProcessContribution
description: An ordered chain of code-graph symbols representing an end-to-end execution flow rooted at an entry point (typically an HTTP `Endpoint`, a message consumer, a scheduled task, or an MCP tool handler). Universal envelope (Pattern-C, SKILL §8bis Rule 2). Producers: `ProcessKS` (DFS over `CodeGraph.CallEdge`), future Joern path-query KS, etc. Processes are a primary input signal to `GranularityKS` and `ArchetypeMatchingKS` (an Archetype's `Application` often corresponds to a coherent set of Processes).

id.description: Stable client-defined identity within (panel, slot). Suggested form: '<extractor>:<entryPointSymbol>:<chainHash>'. Used as the contribution identityKey.

extractor.description: Producer label (analogue of SCIP `SymbolInformation.kind`). Open enum.

entryPoint.description: Where the process starts. The `symbol` SHOULD resolve to a contribution in a code-bearing slot of the same Blackboard.

symbol.description: SCIP-style symbol moniker of the entry function/method.

endpointRef.description: Optional cross-reference to a contribution in `Framework.Endpoint` / `Framework.MessageConsumer` / `Framework.ScheduledTask` (URI form: `bb://...#contrib/<id>`).

steps.description: Ordered list of symbols traversed from the entry point. Each step SHOULD resolve to a contribution in `Index.ScipSymbol` (or `CodeGraph.SymbolRef` for non-SCIP languages) of the same Blackboard. Step 0 is the entry-point symbol itself.

viaCallEdge.description: Optional URI of the `CodeGraph.CallEdge` contribution that produced this step.

truncated.description: True if traversal hit a depth/cycle/time guard before exhausting reachable callees.

cacheKey.description: Determinism marker (SKILL §7b.5) for non-deterministic extractors: SHOULD encode (extractor version, traversal params, repo HEAD SHA, input edge-set hash).

nativeAttributes.description: Free-form escape hatch for extractor-specific attributes (max depth, dataflow tags, etc.). Tool-agnostic consumers ignore.
